desc:
🏟️ Restore the Stadium! 🏟️
Grab your torch 🔥 and melt the mess off 11,000+ seats to bring the stadium back to life!

✅ THINGS TO DO
🔥 Torch dirty seats clean
💰 Earn cash for every seat
👥 Team up with up to 4 friends
🚃 Send melt carts down whole rows
🎲 Spin for rare Classes
⚡ Stack boosts like Friend Boost and Heat Wave
🏆 Restore 100% and beat your best time

USE CODE: STADIUM

👍 Like the game if you enjoy it!
